issue_title: Smarty extension causes generation of invalid HTML syntax
issue_body:
This works as expected: ```console $ echo '![x"x](x)' | python3 -m markdown -x smarty

``` but this unexpectedly generates invalid HTML syntax: ```console $ echo '![x\"x](x)' | python3 -m markdown -x smarty

``` I would expect the second output to be the same as the first. Backslash should suppress special interpretation by Markdown; it should not also *induce* special interpretation by HTML.
